note: gilbarbara/logos, LICENSE.txt CC0 1.0 Universal at this commit. CC0 covers the artwork; the marks remain their owners' trademarks. Rendered and re-traced for measurement only. Rules in bench/compare/logosCc0.ts.

rules.strata: colours = distinct solid fill/stroke paints + referenced gradients (1 | 2-3 | 4-8 | 9+); gradients = any <linear|radialGradient>; kind = -icon file → symbol, else rendered w/h ≥ 2 → wordmark, else symbol
rules.order: within each stratum by sha1(file); allocation = floor min(n, 4) + proportional largest remainder
